- The dev server now runs in middleware mode via Rsbuild, replacing `webpack-dev-middleware` and `webpack-hot-middleware` (#35575).
- We use an Rspack-specific Vue loader for correct SSR scoped-style ids and stricter ESM resolution (#35566).
- **`nuxt module remove`** to uninstall a module and clean up its config ([nuxt/cli#1306](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1306)), the natural companion to `nuxt module add`.

- **Non-interactive `nuxt init`** for scripting and CI ([nuxt/cli#1341](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1341)), plus it now respects the template's own package manager instead of prompting ([nuxt/cli#1330](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1330)).
- **Type-check onboarding**: `nuxt typecheck` now offers to install `vue-tsc` and `typescript` for you if they're missing ([nuxt/cli#1316](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1316)).

- **Golar support for type-checking**: `nuxt typecheck` can now use [Golar](https://golar.dev) as an alternative to `vue-tsc` ([nuxt/cli#1362](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1362)). It's picked up automatically if it's installed (or a `golar.config.*` file exists), and you can force a checker with `--checker=vue-tsc` or `--checker=golar`:

  ```sh
  nuxt typecheck --checker=golar
  ```
- **Layer-aware dev server**: the dev server now reloads on changes to local layer `nuxt.config` files ([nuxt/cli#1345](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1345)).
- **Faster dev startup**: dev-only Nitro and pages work is now deferred and streamlined (#35381, #35383).
- **Leaner production builds**: the island-renderer chunk is skipped entirely when you use no islands (#35456), and plugin handling is tree-shaken out of prod builds (#35278).
- **Improved island hashing**: more stable island and key hashing, with `getIslandHash` and `hashKey` now exposed (#35583).
- **Concurrency and I/O wins** across Kit path resolution and Nitro inline styles (#35511, #35514).
- `$fetch` is now auto-imported in user code, which fixes edge cases with top-level `$fetch.create` under Rolldown's output format (#35581).
- Nuxt now honours system `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` environment variables in the builder environment (#35183).
- HMR now works for `defineNuxtComponent` in JSX (#35620).
- **Vite 8**: check custom Vite plugins and config against the [Vite migration guide](https://vite.dev/guide/migration).
- **Rspack 2**: if you use `builder: 'rspack'`, the internals are now Rsbuild-based, so custom Rspack config may need review.
- **`unhead` v3**: possible breaking *type* changes from stricter `useHead` typing.

- **an interactive terminal UI**, showing URLs, startup progress and keyboard shortcuts, with panels to dive into error logs, routes, network requests and more

- **the dev server gives you more info**, such as why it reloaded or restarted, which `nuxt.config` keys changed, where the time went during a slow start or build, and how long each module took to set up
- **a CLI-level error channel** rendered with `my-bad` (see below), powering things like automatically reloading when a syntax error in `nuxt.config.ts` is fixed

- **a lock file** in `.nuxt/`, which lets a second `nuxt dev` (say, one started by an agent) take over or defer to the one you started, and powers new `nuxt curl` and `nuxt task` commands that talk to the running server

- **`<NuxtLink>` renders 58% faster on the server** ([#36015](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36015)). Internal links are now rendered as a plain `<a>` with no `useLink`, no computed and no reactive state. Rendering 200 links went from 1.36ms to 0.57ms, which is 1.4x faster than a bare `<RouterLink>`.

- **Early 404s** ([#36117](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36117)). With `experimental.early404`, page routes are compiled into a static matcher at build time and requests that can't match any page skip creating the Vue app, running plugins and middleware entirely. On an app with 30 pages and ~23ms of boot work per render, a JSON 404 went from 37.1ms to 0.3ms.

- **Templates declare their dependencies** ([#35875](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35875)). The virtual file templates used in Nuxt's build used to regenerate on every file change. They now declare what invalidates them, so editing a component regenerates 0 of 49 core templates instead of all of them, and the `builder:watch` hook settles in 0.6ms instead of 36ms.

- **Cookie jars** ([#36114](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36114)). `useCookie` parses the cookie header once per request (or once per microtask on the client) instead of on every call. A nice side effect: a cookie set in a plugin during SSR can now be read by a later `useCookie` in a page.
- **`ssr: false` pages are tree-shaken from the server bundle** ([#35836](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35836), thanks to [@Austin1serb](https://github.com/Austin1serb)).
- **Serializable `definePageMeta` keys are extracted at build time** ([#35919](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35919)), behind `experimental.extractSerializablePageMeta`.

- **Faster dev server warm-up**: Vite's server module graph is warmed before the client ([#36154](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36154)), the client graph is crawled during warm-up ([#35870](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35870)), and warm-up yields to your first navigation so it never competes with a real request ([#36412](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36412)).
- **Smaller client bundle**: `unctx` is no longer shipped to the browser and `defu` is skipped for a single `app.config` ([#36371](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36371)).

- **Fewer dependencies**: `@nuxt/kit` no longer depends on `c12`, `untyped`, `confbox`, `pkg-types`, `ufo` or `mlly`, and `jiti` and `giget` are now optional peers loaded only when needed ([#35936](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35936), [#35943](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35943), [#35946](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35946), [#36071](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36071), [#36073](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36073), [#36083](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36083)).

- Lazy impound tracing for builds ([#36172](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36172)), virtual module hooks filtered by id ([#36077](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36077)), `isVue` checks migrated to plugin filters ([#36116](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36116)) and an `flru` prerender cache ([#36340](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36340)).
- **Typed pages** (`experimental.typedPages`) ([#35789](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35789))
- **Typed `$fetch`** (`experimental.routeTypedFetch`), described above
- **Case-sensitive routing**, matching Nitro ([#35650](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35650), thanks to [@Mateleo](https://github.com/Mateleo))

- **Early return from `navigateTo`** (`experimental.navigateToEarlyReturn`): `navigateTo` in `<script setup>` short-circuits the rest of the setup, so redirects and 404s don't throw on missing data ([#36115](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36115))
- **Serializable page meta extraction** (`experimental.extractSerializablePageMeta`)
- **Client-side payload extraction** (`experimental.payloadExtraction: 'client'`)
- **Normalized page names**, `clearNuxtState` resetting to defaults, `experimental.watcher: 'builder'`, and no auto-imported server-only head composables
- **No `baseUrl` in generated tsconfigs** ([#36040](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36040), thanks to [@oritwoen](https://github.com/oritwoen))

- **Inline error rendering** (`experimental.inlineErrorRendering`): when a server render fails, `error.vue` is rendered in the same request with a plain try/catch, instead of re-entering the server over an internal request to `/__nuxt_error`. Headers and cookies the failed render had already set are kept, error renders no longer pass through Nitro middleware and route rules a second time, and `render:html` fires with the original event ([#36399](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36399)).

- **Clickable file paths** in terminal output ([#35898](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35898)). Warnings that mention a file now link to it in your editor, at the line responsible where we know it.

- **IDE hover docs for built-in components** ([#35701](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35701)). Hovering a built-in component like `<NuxtLayout>` or `<NuxtLink>` in a template now shows a short description and a link to the docs. Thanks to [@Ibochkarev](https://github.com/Ibochkarev).

- **`app/types/` and `server/types/`** are included in the right tsconfig, so ambient types and augmentations placed there are picked up ([#35783](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35783), thanks to [@Flo0806](https://github.com/Flo0806), who also added an augmentable `NuxtPageMeta` for typing `NuxtPage.meta` in [#34816](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/34816)).

- **Grouping folders in `components/`**: a `(group)/` folder is excluded from the component name ([#35699](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35699), thanks to [@abaza738](https://github.com/abaza738)).
- **Dynamic `expires` in `useCookie`**, accepting a function ([#35628](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35628), thanks to [@DarlanPrado](https://github.com/DarlanPrado)).
- **A warning when a `public/` file shadows an application route** ([#35674](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35674), thanks to [@Norbiros](https://github.com/Norbiros)).
- **Install hints use your package manager** ([#35871](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35871)).

- **Prerender your error pages** as real HTML (`404.html`, or any status codes you pass) with `experimental.prerenderErrorPages` instead of an empty SPA shell ([#35193](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35193), thanks again to [@Flo0806](https://github.com/Flo0806)).

- `$Fetch` is exported from `nuxt/app` ([#35625](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35625)) and `ShallowRef` is in the Vue auto-import preset ([#36266](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36266)), both from [@DamianGlowala](https://github.com/DamianGlowala); `preloadComponents` and the `NuxtIsland` `name` prop are typed ([#35775](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35775)), and `useLayout`, `useLoadingIndicator` and `useRequestHeader` are exported from `nuxt/app` ([#36033](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36033)).

- **`typescript.tsConfig` is now a shared baseline** for all four generated tsconfigs, with `appTsConfig` and `serverTsConfig` for per-context overrides ([#35697](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35697), thanks to [@chairulakmal](https://github.com/chairulakmal)).

- **Top-level `prerender` option**, an alias for `nitro.prerender` in the same way `runtimeConfig` and `routeRules` are top-level ([#32356](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/32356)). Nuxt now also points you towards top-level options where they exist, since those work across server builders ([#36416](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36416)).

- **Links to `public/` files just work.** If the router has no route for a `<NuxtLink>` target (a PDF in `public/`, say, or a link from Markdown with Nuxt Content), Nuxt falls through to a full-page load instead of rendering your 404, so `external` is no longer required ([#36169](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36169)).

- **Renaming a component in development refreshes its imports**, so you no longer see stale references to the old file ([#36165](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36165), thanks to [@oritwoen](https://github.com/oritwoen)).

- **Layers**: dependencies of layers installed from `node_modules` are pre-bundled by Vite ([#36208](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36208)), and symlinked layer directories resolve to their real path ([#36402](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36402), thanks to [@silverbackdan](https://github.com/silverbackdan)).

- **Nuxt-owned, augmentable server types**: `ServerTypes`, `ServerRoutes`, `AppRouteRules` and `NuxtRequestContext`. Augment `@nuxt/schema` once; `nuxt/schema` mirrors it ([#36293](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36293)).
- **`useTerminal`** for host-aware prompts, status messages and tasks in progress, rendered by the CLI's dev panel when there is one ([#36162](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36162)).
- **`module:before` and `module:done` hooks**, which Nuxt CLI v4 uses to show per-module setup time as it happens ([#36173](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36173)).
- **`onConfigResolved` and `diffNuxtConfig`** to see what changed between two config loads ([#35853](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35853)).

- **`ensureDependencyInstalled` and `getAddDependencyCommand`** to check for and offer to install optional dependencies with the user's package manager ([#34554](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/34554)).
- **Template `dependencies`** to say exactly what should invalidate a template ([#35875](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35875)).

- **`addServerImports`, `addServerImportsDir` and `addServerTemplate`** work the same across Nitro versions; a server tsconfig and versioned route config types are generated for you ([#36265](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36265)).
- **`@nuxt/kit` has an explicit public API** ([#36074](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36074)) and `@nuxt/schema` is an optional peer ([#36246](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36246)).

- Modules can now set `experimental.asyncContext` ([#36175](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36175), thanks to [@cernymatej](https://github.com/cernymatej)), Vite plugins added via kit land at the top level rather than wrapped ([#36037](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36037)), and more build-time warnings have moved to [diagnostic codes](https://nuxt.com/docs/errors) with docs pages ([#36138](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36138)).

- `@nuxt/kit` peer dependency ranges are widened to the versions actually required rather than tracking the latest of each package ([#36417](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36417)), and `updateRuntimeConfig` no longer warns when called before Nitro exists ([#36403](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36403), thanks to [@Neekoras](https://github.com/Neekoras)).

- The internal error route is only served to an error render, and can no longer be reached from outside ([259058cf4](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/259058cf4), [#36305](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36305)).

- Dev error reports are scoped for remote peers, and the dev error channel is kept out of production builds ([#36389](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36389), [#36407](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36407)).

- Unhandled error data is no longer passed to the error page ([38a40cfc0](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/38a40cfc0)), oversized island bodies are drained before being rejected ([#36320](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36320)), and error-render recursion is tracked in request context rather than via a client-controllable header ([d8c729435](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/d8c729435)).

- Awaited `useAsyncData` no longer resolves with unfetched data on hydration ([#36124](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36124)), awaited lazy async data resolves immediately ([#36301](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36301)), and `useAsyncData` types resolve for generic type params ([#36316](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36316)).
- `useRequestFetch` forwards request headers ([#36180](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36180), thanks to [@hdwebpros](https://github.com/hdwebpros)).

- `navigateTo` matches vue-router's path encoding ([#36055](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36055)), preserves percent-encoding in server redirects ([#36112](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36112)), and applies `baseURL` with `open` ([#36197](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36197)).

- Scoped styles apply to server component slots ([#36047](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36047)), island asset requests are deduped ([#36048](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36048)), lazy hydration no longer produces blank remounts ([#36051](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36051)), all from [@oritwoen](https://github.com/oritwoen), and hydrated `nuxt-client` markup is stripped from cached island HTML ([#36298](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36298)).

- A batch of CSS fixes across Vite, webpack and rspack: duplicate CSS links for inlined chunks ([#36056](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36056)), `baseURL` and `url()` rewriting in inlined styles ([#36137](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36137), [#36143](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36143)), island descendant CSS extraction ([#36260](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36260)) and stable style chunk names ([#36361](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36361)).

- View transitions handle interrupted and skipped navigations ([#35537](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35537) from [@Askerka00](https://github.com/Askerka00), [#36314](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36314)), and page transitions stay mounted for nested routes with no children ([#36304](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36304)).
- The streaming shell head renders after the first render pass ([#36120](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36120)).

- Payload URLs are parsed as origin-relative paths, so a path like `//x/_payload.json` no longer serves the wrong payload ([#36409](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36409), spotted by [@Kushalkhemka](https://github.com/Kushalkhemka)).
- `/index.html` is prerendered for client-only apps with islands ([#36299](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36299)).

- `definePageMeta` works at the top level of `setup()` ([#36245](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36245)), and changed auto-import sources are rescanned before their consumers ([#33671](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/33671), thanks to [@Flo0806](https://github.com/Flo0806)).
- A template that never finishes compiling now fails the build instead of exiting 0 ([#36322](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36322)).
- Error causes are preserved in development ([#35632](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/35632), thanks to [@onmax](https://github.com/onmax)).

- Layout `onBeforeLeave` reuses the pending transition promise ([#36395](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36395)), and `baseURL` and middleware flags are respected in apps without `pages/` ([#36034](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36034)).

- `stripNeverHydratedData` no longer mutates the options object ([#36035](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/36035)), the dev error module is stubbed out of production builds ([55e61d75d](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/55e61d75d)), and preloading a component that is not global now warns ([47de80ece](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/commit/47de80ece)).
